name: trait-S03-tail-carriage-a
refs: Our signed young S03, Tuikis (project-owned): the creature, exactly. Its tail, carriage, feet and skin are the middle looks.
prompt: Paint SIX panels in a 3 by 2 grid, equal size, small gaps. Every panel shows the SAME whole creature as the reference, standing exactly as in the reference, large, with clear magenta around it. TOP ROW, the tail's LENGTH and thickness, carried straight up as in the reference: left 'short, thin' (a short thin tail with its yellow bulb), middle 'between' (exactly the reference's), right 'long, thick' (a long thick tail with its bulb). BOTTOM ROW, the tail's CARRIAGE, the reference's tail length: left 'hangs' (the tail hangs down behind, the bulb near the ground), middle 'straight' (held straight out behind, level), right 'curls up' (curled up over the back in a loop, the bulb above). Plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background everywhere, no borders, no text, no numbers. Same brush and soft painterly light from the top left as the reference in every panel; only the named look changes. No props, no ground, no shadow, no glow.
